title: Jakarta - Food Vendor and MRT Distribution Map
gallery_text: The map shows a choropleth of official street vendor density by sub-district, overlaid with Jakarta's MRT (Mass Rapid Transit) North–South line and its stations. It shows how limited the MRT network still is, a single line serves only a narrow part of the city.
description:
Sources: 
Subdistrict Map - https://github.com/SakifAbdillah/jakartaKecamatanGeoJSON/blob/master/kecamatan.geojson
MRT: https://data.go.id/dataset/dataset/data-stasiun-mass-rapid-transit-mrt
Street Vendors: https://data.go.id/dataset/dataset/lokasi-resmi-pedagang-kaki-lima-menurut-kecamatan

These official government datasets combine data from several government departments into a standardized format, mainly for policy-making and public services. I used them to look for a pattern between public transit accessibility and street food vendors. The map isn't modelled on a specific reference; it's an exploration of how to represent data as a choropleth map. It uses the WGS 84 / UTM zone 48S projection (EPSG:32748).
